package.name: aav_diffusion_rs
package.description: The diffusion planner's model worker in Rust: a drop-in for aav_diffusion_planner's worker.py (diffusion_impl:=rust), a challenger. Its ONNX through ONNX Runtime (the ort crate): Core ML on a Mac, the CPU anywhere, TensorRT on the Orin (untested). No ROS: the planner node starts it and talks to it over a pipe; the guard and the lattice's fallback stay in the node.
